subject: Applied Math Sophomore at Middlebury
body:
Hi Shabana,

I'm Max, 20, a current Midd kid building an AI teaching assistant, and we turned down money for it. In 2012 you shut down a scholarship pipeline that had placed $10 million because it was pulling the strongest students out of Afghanistan, which is killing a program on the metric it was winning.

I'm hungry to learn and would love to know where the students who did take those scholarships ended up, and whether that still settles it. If you're open to 10 minutes, I promise I'll pay it forward.

Best,
Max
